description:
Modern Muse is where art meets home. We offer a unique range of high-quality home décor, from personalized metal signs to cozy woven blankets, all designed to bring warmth and personality to every space.

Modern Muse offers a diverse selection of high-quality home décor, including customizable metal signs, cozy woven blankets, stunning canvas art, and beautifully scented candles. Our products are designed to add warmth, personality, and a personal touch to any home, making them perfect for every style and season.

Affiliates get to promote customizable, one-of-a-kind home décor products that customers adore. We also offer free personalized products for affiliates to showcase, with endless creative possibilities!


• Payment Terms:

Earn a 20% commission on total referral sales through your unique affiliate link or coupon code. Payments are made via PayPal.


• Other Information:

Affiliates can choose any product from our store (up to a certain size) to customize or help design. We’ll send it free for them to share with their audience and boost conversions!
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Modern Muse! By using our website or participating in our affiliate program, you agree to the following terms and conditions, as well as our privacy policy. Please read them carefully.

Affiliate Program Terms:

  1. Eligibility: Participants must be 18 years or older and passionate about home décor or design.
  2. Commission: Affiliates earn 20% commission on sales made through their referral link. Commissions are paid via PayPal.
  3. Payment: Store credit is earned after a successful referral purchase and is redeemable on our website. Payments via PayPal may take up to 30 days for verification.
  4. Customization: Affiliates can choose any product (up to a specified size) and customize it, or collaborate with us on a unique design to showcase on their platform.
  5. Prohibited Use: Affiliates may not use spam, false advertising, or unethical methods to generate traffic. Violating this will result in immediate removal from the program.
  6. Termination: Modern Muse reserves the right to terminate any affiliate's participation at any time for any reason, including suspected fraudulent activity.

By participating in our affiliate program or browsing our website, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to our terms and conditions. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at contact@modern-muse.store
